broker_ibkr_modal_title: How to export from Interactive Brokers
broker_ibkr_step1_description: Log in to the Interactive Brokers Client Portal. In the top menu, go to Performance & Reports → Flex Queries.
broker_ibkr_step2_description: Click Create to set up a new Activity Flex Query. If you already have a Flex Query configured, you can skip to step 4.
broker_ibkr_step3_description: Enable the Trades, Cash Transactions, and Corporate Actions sections. The screenshots show exactly which sections to enable and how each should be configured. For every section, mark all fields for inclusion as shown — missing fields may cause incomplete or incorrect reports.
broker_ibkr_step4_description: Make sure the general configuration matches the screenshots exactly. Select the account(s) you want the query to run for. If you cannot select multiple accounts at once, create a separate query for each account and run them individually.
broker_ibkr_step5_description: Give your query a name and save it. You can reuse this query each year.
broker_ibkr_step6_title: Run the query for each year
broker_ibkr_step6_description: IBKR limits Flex Query exports to a maximum of one year at a time. You must run a separate export for each calendar year — for example one for 2024, one for 2025, and so on. It is important to have exports covering your entire account history: missing years may result in a faulty report or cause the generator to fail.
broker_ibkr_step7_description: The download starts automatically after running the query. Store each file in a dedicated folder where you keep all your exports and investment or tax documents, organised by year. This makes it easy to find and re-upload them in future years.
ta_slovenia_kdvp_step1_description: Go to the eDavki portal and log in with your digital certificate or smsPASS.
ta_slovenia_kdvp_step2_description: Click the Dokumenti tab at the top, then select Uvozi from the submenu. This import page is the same for all report types.
ta_slovenia_kdvp_step3_description: Click Uvozi datoteko (Import file), select the Doh_KDVP.xml file you downloaded, and confirm. The form will be pre-filled with your trading data.
ta_slovenia_kdvp_step4_description: Review the imported data for accuracy, then click Oddaj (Submit) to file the report with FURS.
